answer: Treat every agent identity like a museum relic: it must carry an unbroken chain of custody, a signed record from first registration through every handoff, key rotation and stake change, each entry countersigned by a different established party. A forged identity is easy to mint but has no provenance, so it stays in the storeroom instead of the trading floor. Keep privileges frozen like a glacier, thawing a notch only after long verified holding, and weigh accounts like cedar: slow growth that cannot be faked in one season, so cloned fleets hold zero custody and zero weight.
